imp_definitions: SELECT s.name AS esquema,o.name,m.definition FROM DEV_SIIR.sys.objects o JOIN DEV_SIIR.sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN DEV_SIIR.sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE m.definition LIKE '%imp_csv%' OR o.name LIKE '%imp%chancado%'
mov_daily: SELECT CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,COUNT(*) AS Registros,SUM(Ton) AS Ton_SRR,SUM(Ton*CuTG00)/NULLIF(SUM(Ton),0) AS Ley_CuT_SRR_MOV_CAM,MIN(CuTG00) AS Ley_Min,MAX(CuTG00) AS Ley_Max FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' AND Fase='SRR' AND (Destino='prueba' OR Destino='CH01') GROUP BY CAST(Fecha AS date)
resumen_mina_srr: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.resumen_mina WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' AND Fase='SRR'
imp_daily: SELECT CAST([date] AS date) AS Fecha,COUNT(*) AS Registros,COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) AS Batches,SUM(tonnage) AS Ton_SRR,SUM(CASE WHEN cut IS NOT NULL THEN tonnage ELSE NULL END) AS Ton_Con_Ley,SUM(tonnage*cut)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cut IS NOT NULL THEN tonnage ELSE NULL END),0) AS Ley_CuT_SRR_IMP,MIN(cut) AS Ley_Min,MAX(cut) AS Ley_Max FROM DEV_SIIR.hidro.imp_csv WHERE [date] >= '20260901' AND [date] < '20261001' AND shovel='SRR' AND [to]='CH01' AND origen='IMP' GROUP BY CAST([date] AS date)
synonyms: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) AS esquema,name,base_object_name FROM sys.synonyms WHERE name LIKE '%mov_cam%' OR name LIKE '%imp%'
cross_columns: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM DEV_SIIR.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%batch%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%import%'
